inventory.publicFallback: Use the official Spanish DGT DATEX II energy-infrastructure feed as the primary nominative inventory fallback because it exposes operator names per charging site. inventory.dgtFallbackEvidence: DGT NAP publishes the national electric-vehicle charging dataset in DATEX II v3 with MITERD as data owner and DGT as publisher. The live directory exposes electrolineras.xml. @gasolinaradar/dgt-ev-collector 1.5.1 independently documents streaming this official feed and extracting operator.name. REVE /api/public/v1 remains unsupported and optional only.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: EVcharge / Etecnic
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Official EVcharge/Etecnic material describes a charge-point management SaaS/platform used by municipalities, companies and other operators, with customer-configurable tariffs by time, power and user group. Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: Electromaps / Electromaps SL
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Electromaps' current official FAQ states charging tariffs are set by the station owner or CPO, may vary by kWh/minute/fixed fee, and Electromaps can add its own service surcharge. Treat Electromaps as an eMSP/aggregation platform for tariff purposes, not as a physical CPO identity to which one direct tariff can be propagated. Resolve the underlying physical CPO per station/EVSE instead.

aliasesResolved.note: ACCIONA Energía acquired Cargacoches in 2021. Treat as an alias only for the legacy own Cargacoches network; Cargacoches/ACCIONA-managed third-party chargers must not inherit ACCIONA direct tariffs unless physical operation is confirmed.
Zunder's official history states that EasyCharger changed its name and image to Zunder in 2022; current legal entity is Grupo Easycharger S.A.

lastConsistencyCheck.result: Historical validated=22, nominatively reconciled=12, blocked=12, active=2, excluded platform/non-CPO identities=2. The actual main branch was reconciled from da76e4b8; later conversation-level 189/618 denominator states were not present on GitHub and conflict with the ledger's explicit null authoritative total, so they were rejected. Iberdrola | bp pulse moved from active to validated using its current official power-based Spain tariff table. EDP Charge moved from active to fail-closed because its official app is the tariff surface and current public REVE-derived observations show station-level variation without a supported exact public EVSE tariff feed. Electromaps moved from active to excluded platform/eMSP because its own FAQ states the underlying owner/CPO sets the charging tariff and Electromaps may add a service surcharge. No blocked CPO was re-audited without new evidence; no duplicate canonical CPO was added; the historical unreconciled-name gap remains 10.
